answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: each identity's trust score halves every few epochs unless it keeps earning fresh, peer-graded work. A farmer cannot park a thousand accounts in a quiet harbor and wake them for one vote; to keep even a sparrow-sized fake alive he must pay compute for a new original answer every epoch, per account. Holding a fleet atop that trust mesa costs linear, recurring work, so dormant sybils erode to zero.
